exercises.instructionEn: Complete the table, then study the rules.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL IKKI USTUNLI:
  AFFIRMATIVE (tasdiq) / NEGATIVE (inkor)

Kitob ba'zi kataklarni to'ldirib bergan
(qizil rangda), qolganini o'zingiz
to'ldirasiz.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  TASDIQ (Affirmative):
     I / you            HAVE  cleaned
                        (kitob bergan)
     he / she / it      HAS   cleaned
                        (kitob bergan)
     we / you / they    HAVE  cleaned  ←

  INKOR (Negative):
     I / you            HAVEN'T cleaned
                        (kitob bergan)
     he / she / it      HASN'T  cleaned  ←
     we / you / they    HAVEN'T cleaned  ←


TO'LIQ TUSLANISh:

  TASDIQ:
     I have cleaned          we have cleaned
     you have cleaned        you have cleaned
     he has cleaned          they have cleaned
     she has cleaned
     it has cleaned

  INKOR:
     I haven't cleaned       we haven't cleaned
     you haven't cleaned     you haven't cleaned
     he hasn't cleaned       they haven't cleaned
     she hasn't cleaned
     it hasn't cleaned


OLTIN QOIDA — JUDA ODDIY:

  HAS  →  faqat HE / SHE / IT bilan
  HAVE →  qolgan HAMMASI bilan
          (I, you, we, they)

  Inkor:
     hasn't  = has not
     haven't = have not


YASALIShI:
  HAVE / HAS  +  fe'lning III shakli (V3)

  'clean' — TO'G'RI fe'l, shuning uchun
  V3 = V2 = 'cleaned'.


QISQARTMALAR (og'zaki nutqda):
     I have    →  I'VE
     you have  →  YOU'VE
     he has    →  HE'S
     she has   →  SHE'S
     it has    →  IT'S
     we have   →  WE'VE
     they have →  THEY'VE

  DIQQAT — 'HE'S' IKKI MA'NOLI:
     'He'S cleaned it.'  = he HAS cleaned
     'He'S a doctor.'    = he IS a doctor

  Qaysi ekanini KEYINGI SO'Z aytadi:
     keyin V3 kelsa  →  HAS
     keyin ot/sifat  →  IS


DIQQAT — FE'LNING III ShAKLI (V3):

  TO'G'RI fe'llar: V2 = V3 (ikkalasi ham -ed)
     clean → cleaned → CLEANED
     visit → visited → VISITED
     stay  → stayed  → STAYED

  NOTO'G'RI fe'llar: V3 boshqa bo'lishi
  mumkin
     see   → saw   → SEEN
     be    → was   → BEEN
     do    → did   → DONE
     go    → went  → GONE
     eat   → ate   → EATEN
     ride  → rode  → RIDDEN
     drive → drove → DRIVEN
     fly   → flew  → FLOWN

  Ba'zilarida V2 = V3:
     buy   → bought → BOUGHT
     meet  → met    → MET
     have  → had    → HAD


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  affirmative     = tasdiq shakli
  negative        = inkor shakli
  past participle = fe'lning III shakli
  to clean        = tozalamoq

commonMistake.whyUz:
'we, you, they' — 'HAS' EMAS, 'HAVE'.

OLTIN QOIDA:
  HAS  → faqat he / she / it
  HAVE → qolgan hammasi (I, you, we, they)

Qisqartmasi: we'VE, you'VE, they'VE.

'he, she, it' → HAS, inkori HASN'T.

hasn't = has not

'he haven't' — XATO!

'we, you, they' → HAVE, inkori HAVEN'T.

haven't = have not

DIQQAT: inkor shaklda ham xuddi shu qoida —
faqat he/she/it 'hasn't' oladi.

exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI — ENG MUHIM QOIDA


KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We form the PRESENT PERFECT with HAVE/HAS
    and the PAST PARTICIPLE of the main verb.'

 • 'We use the PRESENT PERFECT to talk about an
    action which happened in the past,
    WITHOUT SAYING WHEN it happened.'
      He's BEEN to Spain.
      (We don't know WHEN he went to Spain.)

 • 'We use the PAST SIMPLE to talk about an
    action which happened at a DEFINITE TIME
    in the past.'
      He WENT to Spain LAST MONTH.
      (When did he go to Spain? Last month —
       definite time.)

 • 'TIME ADVERBS used with the PRESENT PERFECT:
    ever, just, yet, already, for, since, etc.'

 • 'TIME ADVERBS used with the PAST SIMPLE:
    yesterday, two/three/etc days/months/etc
    ago, last Monday/week/month, etc.'


O'ZBEKChA — BUTUN UNITNING KALITI:

  VAQT AYTILMAGAN  →  PRESENT PERFECT
     'He's been to Spain.'
     (Qachon borgani NOMA'LUM)

  VAQT AYTILGAN    →  PAST SIMPLE
     'He went to Spain last month.'
     (Qachon? — o'tgan oyda)


VAQT RAVIShLARI — IKKI RO'YXAT:

  PRESENT PERFECT bilan:
     ever      (hech qachon — savolda)
     never     (hech qachon — inkorda)
     just      (hozirgina)
     yet       (hali)
     already   (allaqachon)
     for       (... davomida)
     since     (... dan beri)

  PAST SIMPLE bilan:
     yesterday        (kecha)
     two days ago     (ikki kun oldin)
     three months ago (uch oy oldin)
     last Monday      (o'tgan dushanba)
     last week        (o'tgan hafta)
     last month       (o'tgan oy)
     in 2010          (2010-yilda)


⚠ ENG KO'P XATO:
  'I have seen him YESTERDAY.'      ✗
  'I SAW him yesterday.'            ✓

  'I have gone to Spain LAST MONTH.' ✗
  'I WENT to Spain last month.'      ✓

  ANIQ VAQT ravishi bo'lsa, Present Perfect
  ISHLATILMAYDI!


DIQQAT — 'AGO' va 'FOR' FARQI:
  'two days AGO'  → Past Simple
     'I saw him two days ago.'
  'FOR two days'  → Present Perfect
     'I have been here for two days.'

  Ikkalasi ham 'ikki kun' haqida, lekin:
     ago = O'TMISHDAGI nuqta
     for = HOZIRGACHA davom etgan muddat


NEGA BU FARQ MUHIM:

  'He WENT to Spain.'
     → borgan va (ehtimol) qaytgan; o'tmish
       tugagan

  'He HAS BEEN to Spain.'
     → tajribasi bor; hozirga aloqador

  'He HAS GONE to Spain.'
     → hali u yerda!


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  past participle = fe'lning III shakli
  the main verb   = asosiy fe'l
  an action       = harakat
  definite time   = aniq vaqt
  a time adverb   = vaqt ravishi

points.en: We form the present perfect with have/has and the past participle of the main verb.
points.uz: Present Perfect ni have/has va asosiy fe'lning III shakli bilan yasaymiz.
points.noteUz:
have/has + V3.
To'g'ri fe'llarda V3 = V2 (-ed).

points.en: We use the present perfect to talk about an action which happened in the past, without saying when it happened.  —  He's been to Spain. (We don't know when he went to Spain.)
points.uz: Present Perfect ni o'tmishda sodir bo'lgan, lekin QACHON sodir bo'lgani AYTILMAGAN harakat uchun ishlatamiz. — U Ispaniyada bo'lgan. (Qachon borganini bilmaymiz.)
points.noteUz:
⚠ ENG MUHIM QOIDA:
VAQT AYTILMASA → Present Perfect.

points.en: We use the past simple to talk about an action which happened at a definite time in the past.  —  He went to Spain last month.
points.uz: Past Simple ni o'tmishdagi ANIQ VAQTDA sodir bo'lgan harakat uchun ishlatamiz. — U o'tgan oyda Ispaniyaga bordi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ VAQT AYTILSA → Past Simple.
'He has gone to Spain last month' — XATO!

points.en: Time adverbs used with the present perfect: ever, just, yet, already, for, since, etc.
points.uz: Present Perfect bilan ishlatiladigan vaqt ravishlari: ever, just, yet, already, for, since va h.k.
points.noteUz: Bu so'zlar Present Perfect ni 'chaqiradi'.

points.en: Time adverbs used with the past simple: yesterday, two/three/etc days/months/etc ago, last Monday/week/month, etc.
points.uz: Past Simple bilan ishlatiladigan vaqt ravishlari: yesterday, two/three kun/oy oldin, last Monday/week/month va h.k.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the letter in Ex. 4 and find three things Jack has done and two things Jack hasn't done.
exercises.instructionUz: 4-mashqdagi xatni o'qing va Jek qilgan uchta ishni va qilmagan ikkita ishni toping.
exercises.explanationUz:
105-BETDAGI XATDAN:


JEK QILGAN UCh ISh (HAS DONE):

 1  He HAS VISITED the Khan al-Khalili bazaar.
    Xatdan: 'I've already VISITED the Khan
    al-Khalili bazaar.'

 2  He HAS SEEN the Pyramids and the Sphinx.
    Xatdan: 'I have also SEEN the Pyramids and
    the Sphinx at Giza.'

 3  He HAS BEEN TO a traditional restaurant.
    Xatdan: 'I've BEEN TO a traditional
    restaurant.'


JEK QILMAGAN IKKI ISh (HASN'T DONE):

 1  He HASN'T BEEN on a boat trip down the
    River Nile.
    Xatdan: 'I HAVEN'T BEEN on a boat trip down
    the River Nile yet.'

 2  He HASN'T VISITED the Egyptian Museum.
    Xatdan: 'and I HAVEN'T VISITED the Egyptian
    Museum.'


⚠ DIQQAT — OLMOSh VA FE'L O'ZGARADI:

  Xatda BIRINChI shaxs:
     'I HAVE visited ...'
     'I HAVEN'T been ...'

  Javobda UChINChI shaxs:
     'HE HAS visited ...'
     'HE HASN'T been ...'

  Ya'ni 'have' → 'HAS' ga o'zgaradi
  (chunki 'he' — III shaxs birlik).

  Bu — mashqning eng ko'p unutiladigan qismi!


QANDAY TOPILADI — XATDA IKKI GURUH:

  Xatning 2-XATBOShISI — QILGAN ishlar
  (hammasi TASDIQ Present Perfect)

  Xatning 3-XATBOShISI — QILMAGAN ishlar
  ('There are a lot of things I HAVEN'T
    DONE YET' bilan boshlanadi)

  Kitob ataylab shunday tuzgan.


QO'ShIMChA — XATDAGI PAST SIMPLE GAPLAR
(bular bu mashqqa KIRMAYDI):
     'We visited it on Tuesday.'
     'I bought some souvenirs.'
     'I saw them yesterday.'
     'I even rode a camel.'
     'Abdullah took me there last night.'
     'I tried couscous and falafel.'

  Bular Past Simple da, chunki ANIQ VAQT
  aytilgan yoki tafsilot berilgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to find      = topmoq
  three things = uchta narsa/ish

points.en: 1  He HAS visited the Khan al-Khalili bazaar.
points.uz: U Khan al-Khalili bozoriga borgan.
points.noteUz:
QILGAN (1/3).
Xatdan: 'I've already VISITED the bazaar.'
DIQQAT: 'I have' → 'HE HAS'.

points.en: 2  He HAS seen the Pyramids and the Sphinx at Giza.
points.uz: U Gizadagi ehromlar va Sfenksni ko'rgan.
points.noteUz:
QILGAN (2/3).
Xatdan: 'I have also SEEN the Pyramids and
the Sphinx.'
see → saw → SEEN (V3).

points.en: 3  He HAS been to a traditional restaurant.
points.uz: U an'anaviy restoranda bo'lgan.
points.noteUz:
QILGAN (3/3).
Xatdan: 'I've BEEN TO a traditional
restaurant.'
'been TO' — predlog 'to'.

points.en: 1  He HASN'T been on a boat trip down the River Nile.
points.uz: U Nil bo'ylab qayiqda sayohat qilmagan.
points.noteUz:
QILMAGAN (1/2).
Xatdan: 'I HAVEN'T BEEN on a boat trip ...
YET.'
DIQQAT: 'I haven't' → 'HE HASN'T'.

points.en: 2  He HASN'T visited the Egyptian Museum.
points.uz: U Misr muzeyiga bormagan.
points.noteUz:
QILMAGAN (2/2).
Xatdan: 'and I HAVEN'T VISITED the Egyptian
Museum.'

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the short answers in the table.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL IKKI USTUNLI:
  INTERROGATIVE (so'roq) / SHORT ANSWERS
  (qisqa javoblar)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  HAVE I/we/you/they BEEN to Turkey?
     Yes, I/we/you/they  HAVE.
     No,  I/we/you/they  HAVEN'T.

  HAS he/she/it BEEN to Turkey?
     Yes, he/she/it  HAS.
     No,  he/she/it  HASN'T.


OLTIN QOIDA — QISQA JAVOB SAVOLDAGI
YORDAMChI FE'LNI TAKRORLAYDI:

     'HAVE you been ...?'  →  'Yes, I HAVE.'
     'HAS he been ...?'    →  'Yes, he HAS.'

  Savol qaysi so'z bilan boshlansa, javobda
  ham o'sha so'z qoladi.


SO'ROQ ShAKLI QANDAY YASALADI:

  HAVE / HAS  +  EGA  +  V3  + ... ?

     Have you been to Turkey?
     Has he been to Turkey?
     Have they visited Spain?

  DIQQAT: 'DO' KERAK EMAS!
     'Have you been ...?'    ✓
     'DO you have been ...?' ✗


QISQA JAVOBDA ASOSIY FE'L TAKRORLANMAYDI:
     'Yes, I have.'              ✓
     'Yes, I have been.'         (ortiqcha)
     'Yes, I have been to Turkey.' (juda
                                    ortiqcha)

  Faqat 'have/has' qoladi.


DIQQAT — TO'LIQ ShAKL QISQA JAVOBDA:
  IJOBIY javobda QISQARTMA IShLATILMAYDI:
     'Yes, I HAVE.'   ✓
     'Yes, I'VE.'     ✗

  SALBIY javobda esa qisqartma odatiy:
     'No, I HAVEN'T.' ✓
     'No, I have not.' ✓ (rasmiyroq)

  Bu — barcha qisqa javoblarga taalluqli
  qoida ('Yes, I AM' ✓ / 'Yes, I'M' ✗).


SAVOL SO'ZI BILAN — QISQA JAVOB BO'LMAYDI:
  'WHERE have you been?'
     → 'To Turkey.' (qisqa javob emas,
        to'ldiruvchi)
  'HOW LONG have you been here?'
     → 'Since Monday.'

  Faqat HA/YO'Q savollariga qisqa javob
  beriladi.


BOG'LIQLIK — 105-BETDAGI DIALOG:
     SA: 'HAS Jack VISITED the bazaar?'
     SB: 'Yes, he HAS.'

  Aynan shu qoida ishlatilgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  interrogative = so'roq shakli
  a short answer = qisqa javob
  Turkey        = Turkiya

items.sentence: Have I/we/you/they been to Turkey?  —  Yes, I/we/you/they ......... .

commonMistake.whyUz:
QISQA JAVOB savoldagi yordamchi fe'lni
TAKRORLAYDI:
  'HAVE you been?' → 'Yes, I HAVE.'

DIQQAT: ijobiy qisqa javobda QISQARTMA
ISHLATILMAYDI:
  'Yes, I HAVE.' ✓
  'Yes, I'VE.'   ✗

items.sentence: Have I/we/you/they been to Turkey?  —  No, I/we/you/they .......... .

commonMistake.whyUz:
Salbiy qisqa javob: HAVEN'T.

Salbiy javobda qisqartma ODATIY:
  'No, I HAVEN'T.'  ✓
  'No, I have not.' ✓ (rasmiyroq)

items.sentence: Has he/she/it been to Turkey?  —  Yes, he/she/it ............. .

commonMistake.whyUz:
Savol 'HAS' bilan boshlangan → javob ham
'HAS'.

'he/she/it' — DOIM 'has'.
'Yes, he have' — XATO!

items.sentence: Has he/she/it been to Turkey?  —  No, he/she/it ............... .

commonMistake.whyUz:
Salbiy qisqa javob: HASN'T (= has not).

'No, he haven't' — XATO!
'he/she/it' faqat 'hasn't' oladi.

exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use EVER in QUESTIONS and STATEMENTS.'
      Have you EVER visited Brazil?
      Brazil is the best place I've EVER
      visited.

 • 'We use NEVER in STATEMENTS.'
      I've NEVER visited Cyprus.
      I haven't visited Cyprus.


'EVER' NING IKKI IShLATILIShI:

  1) SAVOLDA — 'hech qachon ...ganmisiz?'
        'Have you EVER visited Brazil?'
        'Have you EVER been to Egypt?'

     Bu yerda 'ever' = umr davomida biror
     marta.

  2) USTUN DARAJA bilan — 'ko'rgan eng ...'
        'Brazil is the BEST place I've EVER
         visited.'
        'It's the MOST beautiful city I've EVER
         seen.'

     Qolip: the + [ustun daraja] + ... +
            I've EVER + V3

     DIQQAT: bu qurilmada 'ever' TASDIQ
     gapda keladi, lekin baribir Present
     Perfect bilan.


'NEVER' — FAQAT TASDIQ ShAKLDA:

     'I've NEVER visited Cyprus.'  ✓
     'I haven't NEVER visited.'    ✗ XATO!

  'never' O'ZI INKOR ma'noni beradi,
  shuning uchun 'haven't' bilan BIRGA
  ishlatilmaydi.

  Ikki xil aytish mumkin:
     'I've NEVER visited Cyprus.'   (never)
     'I HAVEN'T visited Cyprus.'    (haven't)

  Ma'nosi bir xil, lekin 'never' KUCHLIROQ.


'EVER' va 'NEVER' QAYERDA TURADI:

  'have' va V3 ORASIDA:
     Have you EVER visited ...?
     I've NEVER visited ...
     I've EVER visited ...

  'Have you visited EVER?' — XATO.


JAVOB BERISh:

  'Have you ever been to Brazil?'
     Yes, I have.
     No, I haven't.  /  No, I've never been
                        there.


DIQQAT — 'EVER' TASDIQ ODDIY GAPDA
IShLATILMAYDI:
     'I have ever been to Spain.'  ✗
     'I have been to Spain.'       ✓

  'ever' faqat:
     • savolda
     • ustun daraja qurilmasida
     • inkorda ('I haven't ever ...' — bu
       'I've never ...' bilan bir xil)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  ever      = hech qachon (savolda)
  never     = hech qachon (inkor ma'noda)
  a statement = darak gap
  Brazil    = Braziliya
  Cyprus    = Kipr

points.en: We use ever in questions and statements.  —  Have you ever visited Brazil?
points.uz: EVER ni savol va darak gaplarda ishlatamiz. — Braziliyaga borganmisiz?
points.noteUz:
'ever' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.
Savolda: 'umr davomida biror marta?'

points.en: Brazil is the best place I've ever visited.
points.uz: Braziliya — men borgan eng yaxshi joy.
points.noteUz:
USTUN DARAJA qurilmasi:
the + [eng ...] + I've EVER + V3.
Bu yerda 'ever' TASDIQ gapda.

points.en: We use never in statements.  —  I've never visited Cyprus.
points.uz: NEVER ni darak gaplarda ishlatamiz. — Kiprga hech qachon bormaganman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'never' O'ZI INKOR:
'I've never visited' ✓
'I haven't never visited' ✗ XATO!

points.en: I haven't visited Cyprus.
points.uz: Kiprga bormaganman.
points.noteUz:
'I've NEVER visited' bilan bir xil ma'no,
lekin 'never' KUCHLIROQ.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the countries, then make sentences, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Mamlakatlarga qarang, so'ngra namunalardagidek gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N MAMLAKAT:
  Australia, Turkey, Greece, Mexico, Italy,
  Canada, Spain, Poland, Brazil, China


KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA:

  'I've BEEN TO Spain. It's the best country
   I've EVER visited.'

  'I've NEVER been to China.'


IKKI QOLIP:

  BORGAN bo'lsangiz:
     'I've been to [mamlakat].'
     (+ ixtiyoriy baho: 'It's the best country
        I've ever visited.')

  BORMAGAN bo'lsangiz:
     'I've never been to [mamlakat].'


DIQQAT — BU ShAXSIY MAShQ:
  Javob har kimda BOSHQA bo'ladi — o'z
  tajribangizga qarab.

  Quyida NAMUNA javoblar berilgan
  (o'zbekistonlik o'quvchi uchun eng
  ehtimolli variant).


NAMUNA JAVOBLAR (10 mamlakat):

 1  I've never been to Australia.
 2  I've been to Turkey. It's the most
    beautiful country I've ever visited.
 3  I've never been to Greece.
 4  I've never been to Mexico.
 5  I've never been to Italy.
 6  I've never been to Canada.
 7  I've never been to Spain.
 8  I've never been to Poland.
 9  I've never been to Brazil.
10  I've never been to China.

  (Bu — faqat namuna. O'z javobingizni
   yozing!)


USTUN DARAJA QOLIPI — BATAFSIL:

  'It's the BEST country I've EVER visited.'

  Boshqa variantlar:
     'It's the MOST BEAUTIFUL country I've
      ever visited.'
     'It's the MOST INTERESTING place I've
      ever seen.'
     'It's the BIGGEST city I've ever been to.'

  Qolip:
     It's the + [USTUN DARAJA] + [ot] +
     I've EVER + [V3].

  DIQQAT: 'that' tushirib qoldirilgan —
  to'liq shakli:
     'the best country THAT I've ever visited'


DIQQAT — 'BEEN TO' PREDLOG:
  'I've been TO Spain.'  ✓
  'I've been IN Spain.'  — boshqa ma'no
                           (ichkarida bo'lish)
  'I've been Spain.'     ✗


DIQQAT — MAMLAKAT NOMLARIDA ARTIKL:
  Ro'yxatdagi 10 mamlakatning HAMMASI
  ARTIKLSIZ:
     Australia, Turkey, Greece, Mexico, Italy,
     Canada, Spain, Poland, Brazil, China

  ISTISNOLAR (bu ro'yxatda yo'q):
     the USA, the UK, the Netherlands,
     the Philippines

  (Grammar 63-bet, 10-mashq qoidasi.)


DIQQAT — 'NEVER' O'RNI:
  'I've NEVER been to China.'  ✓
  'I never have been ...'      ✗
  'I've been never ...'        ✗

  'never' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Australia = Avstraliya
  Turkey    = Turkiya
  Greece    = Gretsiya
  Mexico    = Meksika
  Italy     = Italiya
  Canada    = Kanada
  Spain     = Ispaniya
  Poland    = Polsha
  Brazil    = Braziliya
  China     = Xitoy

points.en: I've been to Spain. It's the best country I've ever visited.
points.uz: Ispaniyada bo'lganman. Bu men borgan eng yaxshi mamlakat.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 1-NAMUNA.
USTUN DARAJA qolipi:
the + [eng ...] + I've EVER + V3.

points.en: I've never been to China.
points.uz: Xitoyda hech qachon bo'lmaganman.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 2-NAMUNA.
'never' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.

points.en: I've never been to Australia. / I've never been to Greece. / I've never been to Mexico.
points.uz: Avstraliyada / Gretsiyada / Meksikada hech qachon bo'lmaganman.
points.noteUz:
NAMUNA javoblar — o'z tajribangizga qarab
o'zgartiring.
Mamlakat nomlari ARTIKLSIZ.

points.en: I've been to Turkey. It's the most beautiful country I've ever visited.
points.uz: Turkiyada bo'lganman. Bu men borgan eng go'zal mamlakat.
points.noteUz:
NAMUNA.
'most beautiful' — uzun sifat, shuning uchun
'the MOST' bilan.

points.en: It's the most interesting place I've ever seen. / It's the biggest city I've ever been to.
points.uz: Bu men ko'rgan eng qiziqarli joy. / Bu men borgan eng katta shahar.
points.noteUz:
Ustun daraja qolipining boshqa variantlari.
'that' tushirib qoldirilgan.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, use the prompts and the adjectives in the list to ask and answer questions, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda ko'rsatmalar va ro'yxatdagi sifatlardan foydalanib namunalardagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI KO'RSATMA:
  • visit Prague? - last summer
  • ride a camel? - no
  • stay in a big hotel? - last winter
  • eat Chinese food? - last Sunday
  • meet a famous person? - no
  • drive a bus? - no
  • fly in a plane? - a month ago

SIFATLAR:
  exciting, fantastic, amazing, delicious,
  great, awful, horrible, terrible, disgusting


KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA:

  SA: Have you EVER VISITED Prague?
  SB: Yes, I HAVE.
  SA: WHEN DID you VISIT Prague?
  SB: Last summer. It was exciting.

  SA: Have you EVER RIDDEN a camel?
  SB: No, I HAVEN'T. I've NEVER RIDDEN a camel.


IKKI QOLIP:

  A) JAVOB 'HA' bo'lsa (vaqt berilgan):
     SA: Have you ever [V3] ...?
     SB: Yes, I have.
     SA: When did you [V1] ...?
     SB: [vaqt]. It was [sifat].

  B) JAVOB 'YO'Q' bo'lsa:
     SA: Have you ever [V3] ...?
     SB: No, I haven't. I've never [V3] ...


BARCHA YETTI DIALOG:

 1  SA: Have you ever VISITED Prague?
    SB: Yes, I have.
    SA: When did you VISIT Prague?
    SB: Last summer. It was EXCITING.
        (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  SA: Have you ever RIDDEN a camel?
    SB: No, I haven't. I've never RIDDEN a
        camel.
        (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 3  SA: Have you ever STAYED in a big hotel?
    SB: Yes, I have.
    SA: When did you STAY in a big hotel?
    SB: Last winter. It was FANTASTIC.

 4  SA: Have you ever EATEN Chinese food?
    SB: Yes, I have.
    SA: When did you EAT Chinese food?
    SB: Last Sunday. It was DELICIOUS.

 5  SA: Have you ever MET a famous person?
    SB: No, I haven't. I've never MET a famous
        person.

 6  SA: Have you ever DRIVEN a bus?
    SB: No, I haven't. I've never DRIVEN a bus.

 7  SA: Have you ever FLOWN in a plane?
    SB: Yes, I have.
    SA: When did you FLY in a plane?
    SB: A month ago. It was AMAZING.


⚠ ENG MUHIM QISM — III ShAKL (V3):

  Savolda V3, javobda V1 ishlatiladi!

  SAVOL (Present Perfect)   JAVOB (Past Simple)
  ─────────────────────     ──────────────────
  Have you ever VISITED?    When did you VISIT?
  Have you ever RIDDEN?     (—)
  Have you ever STAYED?     When did you STAY?
  Have you ever EATEN?      When did you EAT?
  Have you ever MET?        (—)
  Have you ever DRIVEN?     (—)
  Have you ever FLOWN?      When did you FLY?

  DIQQAT: 'did' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY
  shaklda!
     'When did you EAT?'    ✓
     'When did you ATE?'    ✗
     'When did you EATEN?'  ✗


UCh ASOSIY ShAKL (mashqdagi fe'llar):

  visit  →  visited  →  VISITED   (to'g'ri)
  ride   →  rode     →  RIDDEN
  stay   →  stayed   →  STAYED    (to'g'ri)
  eat    →  ate      →  EATEN
  meet   →  met      →  MET
  drive  →  drove    →  DRIVEN
  fly    →  flew     →  FLOWN

  DIQQAT: 'ridden', 'eaten', 'driven',
  'flown' — bularni YODLASh kerak.


SIFATLAR IKKI GURUHDA:

  IJOBIY:
     exciting  (hayajonli)
     fantastic (ajoyib)
     amazing   (hayratlanarli)
     delicious (juda mazali — faqat OVQAT)
     great     (zo'r)

  SALBIY:
     awful      (juda yomon)
     horrible   (dahshatli)
     terrible   (dahshatli)
     disgusting (jirkanch — ko'pincha OVQAT)

  DIQQAT: 'delicious' va 'disgusting'
  asosan OVQAT haqida ishlatiladi, shuning
  uchun 4-bandga (Chinese food) mos keladi.


DIQQAT — 'FLY IN A PLANE':
  'to fly IN a plane' = samolyotda uchmoq
  ('to fly ON a plane' ham uchraydi,
   lekin 'in' standart)


DIQQAT — 'A MONTH AGO':
  'a month AGO' — PAST SIMPLE ko'rsatkichi.
  Shuning uchun javob: 'A month ago.'
  va 'It WAS amazing.'

  DIQQAT: 'ago' bilan Present Perfect
  ISHLATILMAYDI!


RASM:
  Otliq bronza haykal — Pragadagi mashhur
  Avliyo Vatslav haykali (Wenceslas Square).
  1-bandga ('visit Prague') ishora.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Prague       = Praga (Chexiya poytaxti)
  a famous person = mashhur odam
  to fly       = uchmoq (fly → flew → FLOWN)
  exciting     = hayajonli
  awful        = juda yomon
  terrible     = dahshatli

points.en: SA: Have you ever visited Prague?  SB: Yes, I have.  SA: When did you visit Prague?  SB: Last summer. It was exciting.
points.uz: SA: Pragaga borganmisiz? SB: Ha. SA: Qachon borgansiz? SB: O'tgan yozda. Hayajonli edi.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 1-NAMUNA.
⚠ Savolda V3 ('visited'), 'did' dan keyin
V1 ('visit').

points.en: SA: Have you ever ridden a camel?  SB: No, I haven't. I've never ridden a camel.
points.uz: SA: Tuyaga minganmisiz? SB: Yo'q. Hech qachon tuyaga minmaganman.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 2-NAMUNA.
ride → rode → RIDDEN (V3).
Javob 'yo'q' bo'lsa vaqt so'ralmaydi.

points.en: SA: Have you ever stayed in a big hotel?  SB: Yes, I have.  SA: When did you stay in a big hotel?  SB: Last winter. It was fantastic.
points.uz: SA: Katta mehmonxonada turganmisiz? SB: Ha. SA: Qachon? SB: O'tgan qishda. Ajoyib edi.
points.noteUz:
stay — TO'G'RI fe'l: stayed → STAYED.
'stay IN a hotel' — predlog 'in'.

points.en: SA: Have you ever eaten Chinese food?  SB: Yes, I have.  SA: When did you eat Chinese food?  SB: Last Sunday. It was delicious.
points.uz: SA: Xitoy taomini yeb ko'rganmisiz? SB: Ha. SA: Qachon? SB: O'tgan yakshanba. Juda mazali edi.
points.noteUz:
eat → ate → EATEN (V3).
'DELICIOUS' — ovqat uchun eng mos sifat.
DIQQAT: 'When did you EAT?' ('ate' EMAS).

points.en: SA: Have you ever met a famous person?  SB: No, I haven't. I've never met a famous person.
points.uz: SA: Mashhur odam bilan uchrashganmisiz? SB: Yo'q. Hech qachon uchrashmaganman.
points.noteUz: meet → met → MET (V2 = V3).

points.en: SA: Have you ever driven a bus?  SB: No, I haven't. I've never driven a bus.
points.uz: SA: Avtobus haydaganmisiz? SB: Yo'q. Hech qachon haydamaganman.
points.noteUz:
drive → drove → DRIVEN (V3).
'ridden', 'driven' — '-en' bilan tugaydi.

points.en: SA: Have you ever flown in a plane?  SB: Yes, I have.  SA: When did you fly in a plane?  SB: A month ago. It was amazing.
points.uz: SA: Samolyotda uchganmisiz? SB: Ha. SA: Qachon? SB: Bir oy oldin. Hayratlanarli edi.
points.noteUz:
fly → flew → FLOWN (V3).
'a month AGO' — PAST SIMPLE ko'rsatkichi.
DIQQAT: 'ago' bilan Present Perfect
ISHLATILMAYDI!

exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use ALREADY in POSITIVE STATEMENTS.'
 • 'We use YET in QUESTIONS and NEGATIVES.'

 MISOLLAR:
    Have you packed your suitcase YET?
    No, I haven't. I haven't packed it YET.
    Yes, I have. I've ALREADY packed it.


QISQA JADVAL:

  ALREADY  →  TASDIQ gapda
              'I've ALREADY packed it.'

  YET      →  SAVOLDA
              'Have you packed it YET?'
           →  INKORDA
              'I haven't packed it YET.'


QAYERDA TURADI:

  ALREADY — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA:
     'I've ALREADY packed it.'
     'She has ALREADY left.'

     (Ba'zan gap oxirida ham keladi, lekin
      o'rtada turgani standart.)

  YET — GAP OXIRIDA:
     'Have you packed it YET?'
     'I haven't packed it YET.'

     'Have you YET packed it?' — XATO.


MA'NOLARI:

  ALREADY = allaqachon
     Kutilganidan ERTAROQ bo'lgan ish.
     'I've already packed.' = kutmagan
     edingiz, lekin men allaqachon
     yig'ib bo'ldim.

  YET = hali
     Kutilayotgan, lekin HALI bo'lmagan ish.
     'I haven't packed yet.' = hali
     yig'madim (lekin yig'ishim kerak).

  Ya'ni 'yet' KUTILAYOTGAN ishni bildiradi.


DIQQAT — 'YET' va 'STILL':
  'I haven't packed YET.'
     = hali yig'madim (neytral)
  'I STILL haven't packed.'
     = hali ham yig'madim (sabrsizlik,
       ajablanish)

  'still' — 'haven't' dan OLDIN.


DIQQAT — 'ALREADY' SAVOLDA:
  Ba'zan savolda ham ishlatiladi, lekin
  AJABLANISH ma'nosida:
     'Have you ALREADY packed?'
     = Allaqachon yig'ib bo'ldingizmi?
       (Shunchalik tezmi?)

  Oddiy savolda esa 'yet':
     'Have you packed YET?'


BOG'LIQLIK — 105-BETDAGI XAT:
  'I've ALREADY visited the bazaar.'
     (tasdiq)
  'I haven't been on a boat trip YET.'
     (inkor)
  'There are a lot of things I haven't
   done YET.'
     (inkor)

  Jekning xati bu qoidani aynan ishlatgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  already     = allaqachon
  yet         = hali
  to pack     = (yukni) yig'moq
  a suitcase  = chamadon
  a positive statement = tasdiq gap

points.en: We use already in positive statements.
points.uz: ALREADY ni tasdiq gaplarda ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz: 'already' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.

points.en: We use yet in questions and negatives.
points.uz: YET ni savol va inkor gaplarda ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz: 'yet' — GAP OXIRIDA.

points.en: Have you packed your suitcase yet?
points.uz: Chamadoningizni yig'ib bo'ldingizmi?
points.noteUz:
SAVOL + YET (gap oxirida).
'Have you yet packed it?' — XATO.

points.en: No, I haven't. I haven't packed it yet.
points.uz: Yo'q. Hali yig'madim.
points.noteUz:
INKOR + YET (gap oxirida).
'yet' = hali (kutilayotgan ish).

points.en: Yes, I have. I've already packed it.
points.uz: Ha. Allaqachon yig'ib bo'ldim.
points.noteUz:
TASDIQ + ALREADY ('have' va V3 orasida).
'already' = kutilganidan ertaroq.

items.derived: Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.

groups.ruleUz: ⚠ PRESENT PERFECT va PAST SIMPLE — VAQT RAVISHLARI
EVER / NEVER / YET / ALREADY — QAYERDA TURADI

sentencePatterns.introUz: 106-betdagi qoliplar — Present Perfect ning to'liq tizimi.

patterns.exampleEn: I have cleaned it. He has cleaned it. They haven't cleaned it. She hasn't cleaned it.
patterns.exampleUz: Men uni tozalaganman. U tozalagan. Ular tozalamagan.
patterns.explanationUz:
HAS — faqat he/she/it;
HAVE — qolgan hammasi.

patterns.formula: HAVE / HAS + [ega] + [V3] ... ?   —   Yes, I HAVE. / No, I HAVEN'T.
patterns.exampleEn: Have you been to Turkey? — Yes, I have. Has he been to Turkey? — No, he hasn't.
patterns.exampleUz: Turkiyada bo'lganmisiz? — Ha. U bo'lganmi? — Yo'q.
patterns.explanationUz:
So'roqda 'do' KERAK EMAS.
Qisqa javobda qisqartma ISHLATILMAYDI
('Yes, I've' XATO).

patterns.formula: HAVE you EVER + [V3] ... ?  —  WHEN DID you + [V1] ... ?
patterns.exampleEn: Have you ever visited Prague? — Yes, I have. — When did you visit Prague? — Last summer.
patterns.exampleUz: Pragaga borganmisiz? — Ha. — Qachon borgansiz? — O'tgan yozda.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Savolda V3, 'did' dan keyin V1!
'When did you visited' — XATO.

patterns.exampleEn: I've never been to China. I've never ridden a camel.
patterns.exampleUz: Xitoyda hech qachon bo'lmaganman. Hech qachon tuyaga minmaganman.
patterns.explanationUz:
'never' O'ZI INKOR — 'haven't never' XATO.
'never' — have va V3 ORASIDA.

patterns.exampleEn: It's the best country I've ever visited. It's the most beautiful city I've ever seen.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu men borgan eng yaxshi mamlakat. Bu men ko'rgan eng go'zal shahar.
patterns.explanationUz:
'that' tushirib qoldirilgan.
Bu qurilmada 'ever' TASDIQ gapda keladi.

patterns.exampleEn: I've already packed it. I haven't packed it yet. Have you packed it yet?
patterns.exampleUz: Allaqachon yig'ib bo'ldim. Hali yig'madim. Yig'ib bo'ldingizmi?
patterns.explanationUz:
ALREADY — tasdiqda, have va V3 ORASIDA.
YET — savol/inkorda, GAP OXIRIDA.
